entities.summary: Jonathan "Yoni" Chetboun is an Israeli public figure, businessman, and retired IDF Colonel. Chetboun served as a member of the Knesset, where he sat on the Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee. During his active-duty service, the IDF awarded him the Chief of Staff Citation for actions taken during the Second Lebanon War. He serves as the CEO of KANAF – International Business Development.
